sequential_dependency.intermediate: Reachable anchor distance field, minimum goal-distance terminal anchor, and a deterministic shortest legal route to that terminal.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Recover the black footprint, flood cell distances from red, and traverse only whole-footprint legal anchor configurations from the start.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Choose the terminal or the route midpoint rounded toward it, clear the old block, and paint the same rigid footprint at that anchor.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Neither the terminal nor a route midpoint follows from straight-line proximity: walls and narrow corridors change the reachable configuration graph, and its input-dependent route determines the destination.
